name: 新闻资讯解说
how: 公共领域照片加公开数据做成电视新闻式解说：栏目条、标题、数据卡、标注、滚动出处和字幕固定，切换的是「画面组织」——单图推拉、2.5D 视差分层、多图拼贴分屏，只改一个参数。
en_how: Public-domain photos plus open data become a TV-style news explainer. The show bug, headline, data card, annotations, source ticker and subtitles stay fixed; what switches is how the pictures are organized (single-image Ken Burns, 2.5D depth-layer parallax, or a multi-image split-screen collage), with one parameter.
